name: Atlantis
uniques: Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Coast] tiles
Must be adjacent to [6] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Ice] tiles
Comment [Grants [Culture] to any civilization that discover it.]

name: Garden of Eden
uniques: Must be adjacent to [0] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Desert] tiles
Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Elevated] tiles
Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Forest] tiles
Occurs on latitudes from [0] to [30] percent of distance equator to pole
Fresh water
Comment [Nation that own tile of [Garden of Eden] gain a +2[Science] bonus on [Plantation] tiles.]

name: Garden of Hesperides
uniques: Must be adjacent to [0] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Desert] tiles
Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Elevated] tiles
Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Forest] tiles
Occurs on latitudes from [20] to [60] percent of distance equator to pole
Fresh water
Comment [Nation that own tile of [Garden of Hesperides] gain a unique luxury resource [Golden Apple].]

name: Heavenly Peach Garden
uniques: Must be adjacent to [0] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Desert] tiles
Neighboring tiles will convert to [Grassland] <in tiles without [Grassland]>
Fresh water
Comment [+3[Food] and +1[Gold] to adjacent tiles.]

name: Mount Olympus
uniques: Must be adjacent to [0] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [4] to [6] [Elevated] tiles
Comment [+1[Culture] to adjacent hills and +2[Culture] to adjacent mountains.]

name: Penglai
uniques: Must be adjacent to [1] to [3] [Coast] tiles
Must be adjacent to [6] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Ice] tiles
Neighboring tiles will convert to [Coast] <in tiles without [Coast]>
Occurs on latitudes from [0] to [60] percent of distance equator to pole
Comment [Nation that own tile of [Penglai] has its new Land Military units start with [March] ([heal every turn, even if it performs an action]) when train in the capital.]

name: Yggdrasil
uniques: Must be adjacent to [0] [Water] tiles
Must be adjacent to [0] [Desert] tiles
Must be adjacent to [2] to [6] [Forest] tiles
Grants [Sentry] ([[+1] Sight]) to adjacent [{Military} {Land}] units for the rest of the game
